receipts.detail: scripts/test-execution-report.js owns schema lagrange-test-execution-report/v1, its writer (runner sections, producer report) and its validator executionReportProblems; scripts/run-test-files.js writes sections, run-release-proof.js, push-gate-change-proof.js reportedGateRun and publish-head.js writeLocalCorpusReport build reports through it; scripts/proof-authority.js recordProof validates through it. No second receipt format: the receipt gains an execution record inside the existing lagrange-proof-receipt schema.

falsifiers absent, partial, schema, sha-mismatch, tree-mismatch, not-clean, identity-mismatch, identity-unverifiable, run-other-checkout, reused-proof and cli-without-report each refused with the typed execution-report-* code and no proof ref on the remote; red before the fix (red-before-fix.log: 17 of 18 failing) and red on revert (red-on-revert.log; red-on-revert-added-falsifiers.log for schema/not-clean/run-failed)

falsifiers failed-command, run-failed, failed-file, skipped-file, zero-assertion and truncated refused with typed codes; a local-corpus rest run without its gate's cone report is a partial report (red-local-corpus-cone-missing.log before the fix); a green push-gate exit that ran nothing (as solve-land reuse does) leaves the planned corpus unexecuted (push-gate-change-proof.test.js)

the runner keeps every attempt (first failure beside the retry pass); passed-on-retry is refused under the sealed REFUSE policy of release-full-v1 and corpus-full-v1; under ADMIT_QUALIFIED the receipt outcome is passed-qualified carrying the attempts and does not resolve as proven under a refusing contract; a test file never inherits the sections file, so a test's own nested runner never enters the proof report (red-nested-runner-sections.log before the fix)

full-gate.yml uploads the gate's report and record_proof passes --report; publish-head recordProvedCorpus and runLocalCorpus, push-gate recordCorpusProof pass --report; run-release-proof writes the report and its hint; RELEASE.md local path records inside the exact checkout from its report. Old receipts resolve unchanged (reuse test), identity-catalogued reuse (release-proof-identity.test.js), canary resolveCorpusProof and release.yml checks are untouched; run-release-proof cites a reused corpus receipt which the authority re-resolves. Not exercised end to end: a live full-gate or check:release run.

receipts.reason: awaiting the fresh verifier spawned by the lead
